# MaximumLikelihood_Channel_Decoding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A decoding approach that finds the most probable transmitted codeword given the received signal, formulated as an energy minimization problem suitable for Ising machines. Provides a principled framework for error correction in network links, allowing TCC architectures to leverage physical-layer intelligence for topology-aware communication.
